create_RadioConfig: create a RadioConfig instance with model_name and image_size for a vision transformer
lookup_VIT_TIMM_DIM_BY_NAME: lookup ViT architecture dimensions from VIT_TIMM_DIM_BY_NAME by model name
configure_image_normalization: configure image normalization using OPENAI_CLIP_MEAN and OPENAI_CLIP_STD values
setup_video_temporal_encoding: setup video temporal patch size and separate video embedder in RadioConfig
configure_teacher_models: configure a list of teacher model dicts with cls_token_per_teacher in RadioConfig
